summary: The change violates the absolute-path preservation criterion. Task 1.7 must remain incomplete until absolute paths remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

findings.title: Absolute paths are normalized instead of preserved
findings.evidence: The function passes `diffPath`, every artifact path, and `cwd` through `resolve(invocationDirectory, path)` without checking `isAbsolute(path)`. `resolve` rewrites absolute paths containing lexical segments. For example, `/var/root/link/../artifact` becomes `/var/root/artifact`. This can change the target when `link` is a symbolic link, causing preflight to access or verify a different artifact than the caller specified.
findings.recommendation: Return each path unchanged when `isAbsolute(path)` is true. Resolve only relative paths against `invocationDirectory`. Add absolute-path tests containing `..` or another lexical form that `resolve` would rewrite. Keep OpenSpec task 1.7 incomplete until this is fixed.

findings.title: Relative test paths use hard-coded separators
findings.evidence: The new test constructs `run/artifacts/diff-patch` and `run/artifacts/${artifactId}` with `/` instead of using `node:path` construction. This does not satisfy the explicit platform-neutral path-construction criterion.
findings.recommendation: Construct these relative paths with `join("run", "artifacts", ...)` and use the same values in the expectations.
